# SteezeDrip

> Small-batch streetwear-couture, cut in Lagos, Nigeria, worn everywhere. Exclusive drops, heavyweight cottons, hand-finished patches, no restocks.

## About
SteezeDrip is an independent luxury streetwear label founded in Lagos, Nigeria by Only1kuzzy. The brand produces limited-edition apparel, merging African heritage with contemporary high-fashion street culture. Each drop is produced in strictly limited runs to maintain exclusivity and craft integrity.

## Products & Drops
SteezeDrip garments feature:
- 300+ GSM heavyweight custom-milled cotton
- Hand-finished screenprint and embroidery
- Double-needle stitch construction
- Custom woven interior tags and serial-numbered neck tags

1. Average Nigerian Tee — ₦60,000 / $45 (Charcoal / Cream, Heavyweight 320 GSM graphic tee)

5. Drip Acid-Wash Oversized Hoodie — ₦95,000 / $72 (Washed Indigo, 460 GSM french terry)

## Payment & Fulfillment
- Accepted Currencies: Nigerian Naira (NGN), United States Dollar (USD)
- Payment Gateway: Paystack (Debit Cards, Credit Cards, Bank Transfers, USSD)
- Delivery Timelines:
  - Lagos: Same-day to 48 hours
  - Nationwide Nigeria: 2–4 business days
  - International (Worldwide): 5–10 business days via DHL / FedEx Express
- Return Policy: 7-day exchange window for unworn items with original tags. Due to limited batch production, no drop is restocked.
